name: What are common mistakes in custom spa construction?

mainEntity.name: What are common mistakes in custom spa construction?
mainEntity.text: What are common mistakes in custom spa construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common mistakes happen before construction is even underway. Homeowners and builders sometimes under-plan site access, drainage, electrical capacity, and equipment placement, which creates expensive fixes later. Another frequent issue is choosing finishes or features that look good but are difficult to maintain or repair. Vague estimates are also risky because they hide exclusions and make change orders more likely. In Los Angeles-area projects, the biggest avoidable mistakes often involve tight access, inadequate utility planning, and ignoring how the spa fits the rest of the yard. A well-built spa should be easy to use, easy to service, and appropriate for the site. The best way to avoid mistakes is to insist on a detailed design process, clear drawings, and a contractor who can explain the reasoning behind each major decision. The right planning upfront is cheaper than correcting problems after the spa is finished.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common mistakes include poor drainage, undersized equipment, weak site planning, vague estimates, limited service access, and finishes that do not match the maintenance budget. These problems often cause extra cost after the spa is built.
